name: Illumea Anti-Aging Cream 100ml
short_description: Reclaim youthful, radiant skin with Illumea’s Anti-Aging Cream, a sophisticated formula designed to address the visible signs of aging while enhancing your skin’s natural beauty. This luxurious cream combines a blend of advanced ingredients to deliver comprehensive anti-aging benefits, promoting a smoother, more youthful complexion.
description:
Key Active Ingredients:

  • Ethyl Ascorbic Acid: A potent form of Vitamin C, Ethyl Ascorbic Acid brightens and revitalizes the skin while defending against environmental damage. It helps to reduce the appearance of dark spots and enhances overall radiance.
  • Alpha Arbutin: This natural brightener inhibits melanin production, helping to fade age spots and hyperpigmentation, resulting in a more even and luminous skin tone.
  • Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): Known for its ability to improve skin texture and tone, Niacinamide reduces the appearance of fine lines, enhances radiance, and strengthens the skin barrier for a smoother, more youthful look.
  • Kojic Di Palmitate: Renowned for its skin-lightening properties, Kojic Di Palmitate targets hyperpigmentation and dark spots, offering a safer alternative to hydroquinone for a clearer, more even complexion.
  • Vitamin A Acetate: Also known as Retinyl Acetate, Vitamin A promotes cell turnover and collagen synthesis, reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while improving skin texture and elasticity.
  • Lactic Acid: A gentle exfoliant, Lactic Acid helps to remove dead skin cells and improve hydration, revealing a brighter, more refined complexion.
  • Vitamin E: A powerful antioxidant that protects the skin from oxidative stress, Vitamin E supports moisture retention and enhances skin softness, contributing to a more youthful appearance.
  • Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5: This advanced peptide stimulates collagen production, improving skin firmness and reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles for a smoother, more youthful look.
  • Aloe Vera: Known for its soothing and hydrating properties, Aloe Vera calms and nourishes the skin, providing additional comfort and support.
  • Glycolic Acid: An Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) that exfoliates and brightens the skin by removing dead cells, Glycolic Acid enhances skin clarity and promotes a more even tone.

Experience the transformative effects of Illumea’s Anti-Aging Cream, where cutting-edge ingredients work together to rejuvenate, brighten, and smooth your skin. Embrace a youthful, radiant complexion and enjoy the confidence of beautifully refreshed skin.

name: Illumea Fairness and Sun Protective Day Cream 50g
short_description: Illuminate your complexion and safeguard your skin with Illumea’s Fairness and Sun Protective Day Cream, a sophisticated formulation designed to provide advanced sun protection while enhancing your skin’s natural radiance. This all-in-one day cream combines potent ingredients to offer comprehensive skincare benefits, ensuring your skin stays luminous, protected, and youthful.
description:
Key Active Ingredients:

  • Avobenzone: A leading broad-spectrum sunscreen agent, Avobenzone offers effective protection against UVA rays, helping to prevent sun-induced aging and skin damage. When used as directed, it ensures your skin remains shielded from harmful sun exposure.
  • Alpha Arbutin: Derived from the bearberry plant, Alpha Arbutin is a natural skin brightener and antioxidant. It helps to reduce melanin production, improving the appearance of age spots, freckles, melasma, and post-inflammatory pigmentation for a more even skin tone.
  • Ethyl Ascorbic Acid: This powerful form of Vitamin C acts as a potent antioxidant, combating free radicals and protecting the skin from environmental stressors. It helps to prevent premature aging and enhance overall skin brightness.
  • Kojic Di Palmitate: Renowned for its skin-lightening properties, Kojic Di Palmitate reduces dark spots and hyperpigmentation, offering a safer alternative to hydroquinone for a clearer, more even complexion.
  • Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): This versatile ingredient improves skin texture by minimizing enlarged pores, tightening lax skin, and reducing fine lines and wrinkles. Niacinamide also enhances uneven skin tone and boosts radiance, making your complexion appear healthier and more vibrant.
  • Lactic Acid: As a gentle exfoliant, Lactic Acid helps to smooth and brighten the skin by removing dead cells and improving hydration. It contributes to a softer, more refined skin surface.
  • OMC (Octyl Methoxycinnamate) & Tinorsorb-M: These advanced sun filters offer broad-spectrum UV protection, shielding your skin from both UVA and UVB rays to prevent sunburn and premature aging.
  • Benzophenone-4: This UV filter helps to protect the skin from the harmful effects of sunlight, contributing to the overall effectiveness of the sunscreen.
  • Aloe Vera: Known for its soothing and hydrating properties, Aloe Vera calms and moisturizes the skin while providing additional protection and comfort.

Transform your daily skincare routine with Illumea’s Fairness and Sun Protective Day Cream, where advanced sun protection meets skin-brightening technology. Enjoy a luminous, protected complexion every day, and embrace your natural radiance with confidence.
